ATTACHMENT: Overview of Activity  
ABBREVIATIONS 
JASDF: Japan Air Self-Defense Force

Russian aircraft activity around Japan 
- In the afternoon of Friday, October 9, 2026, JASDF spotted a Russian 
aircraft over the Sea of Japan, the Sea of Okhotsk and the Pacific Ocean.  
- JASDF fighters conducted scrambles to monitor the activity of this 
aircraft. https://t.co
